context: The house rule (tokens.md) says phone navigation uses a bottom tab bar. C3 breaks it on purpose: folded, the phone is held in one hand with a card in the other, and unfolded it rests on the table, so the pose picks the mode. Apple's tab-bar page expects a tab bar for sections, and a screen reader user gets no list of sections. Only matters if you pick C3 in item 62. All screens, both Duo poses and themes: designs/d4-banchi-phone-v2/phone-blind-1.html (open one with #s=c3-full) and its notes on the roadmap branch. All cards, orders and buyers are made up. Unmeasured: the unfolded Duo height and insets and the folded top inset (drawn 644 pt).
